pairs.why: Both are almost the same navy, softly lit safe with gold dial and handle, and neither has a finish or shape difference large enough to choose between them.
A has a clean top, while B has a small gold crown ornament on its top edge that looks copied from the phone-booth reference and doesn't belong on a real safe.
A's soft, even sheen is closer to the vending machine, while B's sharper rim highlights and stray top ornament push it slightly toward a polished statue.
The two renders are nearly identical in shape, color, light and finish, so neither is closer.
A's slightly fuller, rounder body and gentler highlights are marginally closer to the soft-plastic finish of the real cards.
The differences are tiny (B's dial is a touch brighter), and neither matches the real cards better.
B's dial and handle are a bit glossier with harder specular highlights, while A's metal reads softer, like the real props.
Both are the same well-built, smooth-but-not-ultra-smooth safe with no meaningful difference in rendering.
